review.method: Reference headings, section endpoints and continuity decisions selected by reading cached source HTML/text independently of pipeline factor IDs or match output. Labels are a development pilot, not a held-out human gold standard.
limitations: Five deliberately selected pairs; not representative of the S&P 500.
Heading-start detection is measured; exact factor body-end accuracy and change-type correctness are not measured.
Split/merge groups express all labeled continuity edges; one-to-one alignment cannot recover every edge.
Unresolved continuity groups are reported and excluded from alignment and added/removed metrics.

metric_definitions.section_boundaries: Start anchor in first 1000 normalized characters AND exact normalized end-anchor suffix; all filings included, even flagged ones. Not full text accuracy.
metric_definitions.heading_starts: One distinct predicted risk unit must start with each reference heading. Does not measure exact body-end segmentation.
metric_definitions.links_end_to_end: Micro precision/recall of labeled continuity edges including segmentation misses and split/merge edges. Unmapped units count as false predictions.
metric_definitions.links_on_detected_headings: Conditional micro precision/recall restricted to links whose two reference heading starts were detected. Read alongside heading recall and end-to-end links.
metric_definitions.added_removed: Standalone factor additions/removals, not new/deleted topics. Split/merge continuations are not additions/removals. Unresolved reference endpoints excluded.
metric_definitions.undefined: A zero denominator produces null, never a fabricated perfect score.

We are subject to complex and changing laws, regulations, policies, and executive orders, which exposes us to potential liabilities, increased costs and other adverse effects on our business.
